subject: CS471
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering all topics. The English selections are strong, featuring highly-rated videos from reputable channels like Computerphile and PwnFunction. The Arabic selections are also strong, with comprehensive lectures and practical labs from channels like Nakerah Network and DR. Process. One topic in Arabic, 'Buffer Overflow Defenses', had very few candidates, requiring the use of a view-count exception to select the best available option.

videos.title: Running a Buffer Overflow Attack - Computerphile
videos.topic_en: Stack Buffer Overflow and Return Address Overwrite
videos.topic_ar: تجاوز سعة المخزن المؤقت في المكدس وتخطي عنوان العودة
videos.filter_reason: A classic, highly-viewed Computerphile video that masterfully explains the concept and demonstrates a full stack overflow exploit to gain root privileges.

videos.title: #12 Demo Canaries | W^X & ASLR for Buffer Overflow Prevention
videos.topic_en: Buffer Overflow Defenses (ASLR, DEP, and Canaries)
videos.topic_ar: تقنيات الحماية من تجاوز سعة المخزن المؤقت (ASLR, DEP, Canaries)
videos.filter_reason: This academic lecture from NPTEL is the most comprehensive video that passes all gates, clearly demonstrating Canaries, W^X (DEP), and ASLR.

videos.title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Explained
videos.topic_en: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Contexts and DOM-based XSS
videos.filter_reason: An exceptionally clear and visually engaging explanation from PwnFunction that uses animation to help students differentiate between Stored, Reflected, and DOM-based XSS.

videos.title: SQL Injection Beginner Crash Course
videos.filter_reason: This zSecurity crash course provides a solid, comprehensive overview covering error-based, union-based, and the more complex Blind SQLi techniques.

videos.title: Time of Check/ Use (TOC/TOU) Attack - Race Condition
videos.topic_en: Defensive Programming and TOCTOU Race Conditions
videos.filter_reason: A concise and clear animated video that directly explains the concept of Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) race condition attacks.

videos.title: Buffer Overflow شرح | OSCP Preparation | Ethical Hacking 0x5
videos.topic_en: Stack Buffer Overflow and Return Address Overwrite
videos.topic_ar: تجاوز سعة المخزن المؤقت في المكدس وتخطي عنوان العودة
videos.filter_reason: This video from Nakerah Network's excellent series specifically covers overwriting the EIP to hijack execution flow, directly addressing the core of the topic.

videos.title: تقنيات الحماية من ثغرات Buffer overflow  , الدرس الثالث
videos.topic_en: Buffer Overflow Defenses (ASLR, DEP, and Canaries)
videos.topic_ar: تقنيات الحماية من تجاوز سعة المخزن المؤقت (ASLR, DEP, Canaries)
videos.filter_reason: Selected as the best available option; while it focuses on general defenses like SEH, it was the only relevant video to pass the gates (via view count exception).

videos.title: 29- شرح ثغرات XSS (Reflected, Stored and DOM based XSS)
videos.topic_en: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Contexts and DOM-based XSS
videos.filter_reason: A comprehensive, highly-viewed lecture that explicitly covers and differentiates between Reflected, Stored, and DOM-based XSS, making it ideal for in-depth learning.

videos.title: الدرس 11 : الحقن الأعمى بالاستجابة الشرطية عن طريق حقن sqli - portswigger
videos.filter_reason: This practical lab from DR. Process provides a clear, step-by-step walkthrough of Blind SQL injection, effectively teaching the more difficult part of this topic.

videos.title: Attacks In Arabic - Race Condition (Time-Sensitive Bugs)
videos.topic_en: Defensive Programming and TOCTOU Race Conditions
videos.filter_reason: A thorough and well-regarded video from CyberBugs that explains the cause of race conditions, demonstrates exploitation, and reviews real-world reports.
